answer: PoA makes Sybil creation costly by requiring each agent to prove, through remote attestation, that its code runs in an approved enclave with the expected MRENCLAVE measurement. A copied virtual machine cannot forge the hardware-rooted report; an attacker needs genuine attestation-capable silicon and must satisfy platform checks. The fable of effortless cloning, a sonnet of trust, and a prism of measurements do not replace that verification.
